notes.title: Major Update and a Big Discount.
notes.content:
Announcing Major Updates to Typing Hero!
We're thrilled to announce some exciting changes and improvements to our game, Typing Hero. These updates are the result of our team's hard work and dedication to providing the best possible gaming experience for our players.

New Main Menu with Animated Intro
The first thing you'll notice when launching the game is our brand new animated main menu. We've put a lot of effort into creating a visually stunning and engaging intro that sets the tone for the game. 

Introducing the "Typing Hero" Theme Song
To complement the game's new look and feel, we've composed an original theme song called "Typing Hero". This catchy tune will play in the background as you navigate through the game's menus and levels. We believe it perfectly captures the spirit of the game and will get you pumped up for some intense typing action.

Game Title Change to "Typing Hero"
In line with the new theme song and animated intro, we've decided to change the game's title from its previous name to "Typing Hero". We felt this new name better reflects the game's focus on improving typing skills while providing an engaging and enjoyable gaming experience. We hope you're as excited about these changes as we are! The updated version of the game is now available for download. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team. 

Game Icon and Game Logo changed
Because of the new name of our game, we also changed the Game Icon and Game logo to reflect the new name.

Discount of 60% off
We also running a big discount of 60% off so new players can become heroes as well. 

Native Support
We want to inform our players that our games have and will always have Native Support for all Platforms:

 Windows Native,
 Linux Native,
 and OSX Native.


Happy typing, heroes!

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.0.3
notes.content:

Happy Typing

Thank you,

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.0.0.0
notes.content:
Highlights

 Implemented Character Customization, so the players will be able to customize their character looks, heads, and skin.
 Implemented Different Weapons. In the past, there was only one type of firearm.
Now we added four (4) different weapons with different attacks and upgrades ( Pistol, Shotgun, Sniper, and Rocketlauncher ).
 Implemented Upgrades; We added Body armor that provides extra health and the option to purchase weapons and upgrade them.
 Custom Dictionary (based on players' request); Implemented the option to load a custom dictionary with custom words for typing.
Colour Blindness Mode (based on players request);
 Font size option (based on players request);
 Difficulty Levels are now available for all maps. Greater Difficulty comes with greater rewards.
 Maps; Added five (5) more new maps, making a total of ten (10) maps.
 Achievements; added more Achievements for all the new features we added. Weapons, Armors, Upgrades, etc.
 Changed the Bosses models to different ones with different gameplay boss mechanics from the previous ones.

Gameplay

 Changed Gameplay from Four Basic Characters to One Customizable and Upgradable Character.
 Changed instead of one selected word while typing, to have multiple selected words that start with the same letter, and do not need to have unique words for each letter. The words are getting filtered out, as more characters/letters you type.
 During the "Special" animation, the player now is invulnerable.

Combat

 New Weapons, four weapons have now been added instead of one. The characters start with a Pistol, and they can buy the rest three weapons with the points they gather during gameplay. 
 All New weapons are upgradable from the Upgradable menu.

UI

 Removed bosses health life indicator ( Hearts ) and added a global health life indicator.
 Word Statistics; in the Main Menu, each player can find their Word Statistics under the "Statistics" page.
 During gameplay, in the in-game menu, added options for volume, music, sound and also Hand Placement
 Hand Placement (based on players request);
 Character Customization Screen, under Customize.
 Added Difficulty levels options to choose while selecting the map to play.
 Added Upgrades in both main-menu and in-game menu.
 Changed How-To-Section, to include Upgrades, New Gameplay, and Custom Dictionary.
 Colour Blindness Mode (based on players request);
 Font size option (based on players request);

Sounds

 Added new Sound effects for all the weapons. Each weapon now has sound effects with variations.

Voices

 Added Voices for the main character for different actions and occasions 

Music

 Added Music for every map. 

Bugs Fixes and Optimization

 Maps Optimization, reduced loading in all of the maps.
 Upgraded the game's project to the Unity 2022.3 LTS version.
 Switched the game's pipeline from the build-in to the URP (Universal Render Pipeline).
 The previous setup had one (1) officer and four (4) squad members, because of that, it it was impossible to add Character Customization and Skills and Upgrades. It has changed to be changed to One (1) Playable Character Only.
 During the "Special" animation, the player now is invulnerable.
